_comment: DERIVED, not verbatim. Instances each derived schema in this directory MUST accept (valid true) or MUST REJECT (valid false); run by check-schemas.derived.py. `via` says what rejects a valid:false case: `schema` (the JSON Schema alone) or `semantic` (a rule of check-schemas.derived.py that JSON Schema cannot state). Cases whose why starts SILENT are inputs the source does not bind, or binds only against a list outside it (a SLSA_ string outside the level form is forbidden as a custom value, R-0081, and allowed as a SLSA-endorsed value such as a verified property, L196): they are ACCEPTED on purpose and stay here so a later tightening is a visible change. source_lines locate the sentence of SLSA VSA v1.2 (.cache/slsa-vsa-1-2.txt) that licenses the verdict. Instances are chosen by this library, not copied from the source.

tests.why: all fields present (shape of the section 4 example)
inputAttestations entry without uri (uri is SHOULD)
dependencyLevels empty object: no dependency at all
dependencyLevels null: verifier makes no claims
dependencyLevels key FAILED and a custom key
verifiedLevels with a custom (non-SLSA_) property beside a level
verifiedLevels with one level per track (BUILD and SOURCE)
verifier with an extra member (object to allow additional fields)
policy without uri (MUST contain a uri)
inputAttestations entry without digest (MUST contain a digest)
inputAttestations entry uri is a number
inputAttestations entry digest is a string

SILENT: verifiedLevels element SLSA_BUILD_3 starts with SLSA_ but is not in the level form: forbidden as a custom value, allowed as a SLSA-endorsed value (L196); only SLSA's own list of values, outside this source, could tell an endorsed value from a forbidden custom one (R-0081)
verifiedLevels element SLSA_BUILD_LEVEL_X (not a number or UNEVALUATED)
verifiedLevels element with a trailing newline
verifiedLevels element SLSA_BUILD_LEVEL_3 with a suffix
verifiedLevels two levels in one track (R-0054, L199)
verifiedLevels a level and UNEVALUATED of the same track
dependencyLevels count is negative (inferred: a count)

SILENT: dependencyLevels key SLSA_BUILD_3, SLSA_ prefixed outside the level form; only SLSA's own list of values, outside this source, could tell an endorsed value from a forbidden custom one (R-0081)
SILENT: timeVerified any string (Timestamp format is in-toto's)
SILENT: verificationResult PASSED beside verifiedLevels FAILED
SILENT: leading zeros in a level number
SILENT: track name containing an underscore
SILENT: empty-string verifiedLevels element counts as a custom value
my_custom_result: custom value not starting with SLSA_
slsa_build_level_1: lower-case: not SLSA_ prefixed, so custom
XSLSA_BUILD_LEVEL_1: SLSA_ not at the start: custom
SLSAX: does not start with SLSA_: custom
SILENT: 'SLSA_' alone is not in the level form; only SLSA's own list of values, outside this source, could tell an endorsed value from a forbidden custom one (R-0081)
SILENT: 'SLSA_BUILD' (no LEVEL) is not in the level form; only SLSA's own list of values, outside this source, could tell an endorsed value from a forbidden custom one (R-0081)
SILENT: 'SLSA_BUILD_LEVELS_3' (LEVELS) is not in the level form; only SLSA's own list of values, outside this source, could tell an endorsed value from a forbidden custom one (R-0081)

SILENT: 'SLSA_BUILD LEVEL_3' (a space where the level form has an underscore) is not in the level form; only SLSA's own list of values, outside this source, could tell an endorsed value from a forbidden custom one (R-0081)
subject without name (Statement rules are outside this source)
subject entry name is a number
subject entry digest is a string
predicateType minor-versioned (the URI carries the major only)
predicate invalid (two levels in one track)

verifiedLevels with a level and a verified property (L195-197): SLSA_BUILD_REPRODUCED is SLSA's name for one (its verified-properties page at ae7fc76, outside this source), SLSA_ prefixed and not in the level form; pass 1's grammar rejected it

SLSA_SOURCE_TWO_PARTY_REVIEWED: a verified property, a SLSA-endorsed value outside the level form (L196, L402-404; the name is from SLSA's verified-properties page at ae7fc76, outside this source); pass 1's grammar rejected it
dependencyLevels key in the level form with no level number (SLSA_BUILD_LEVEL_X): the keys are SlsaResult values (L209); replaces T-066 as the case that binds propertyNames once T-066 became SILENT
